item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["8fb0b7194c5c77ae70b0"],"operation":"Unpack an object member with a typed string format and an error destination.","condition":"The selected member has the wrong type.","capability":"Report a wrong-type diagnostic that includes the object member key; json_unpack provides no error destination.","consequence":"The keyed diagnostic cannot be observed through the fixed entry.","equivalence_reason":"This concerns the changed diagnostic content and requires an error destination."},{"member_ids":["7bd74aa7add4aa6f6cd1"],"operation":"Validate an object member while unpacking it with a typed string format.","condition":"The selected member is not a string.","capability":"Reject the member through string type validation; the fixed entry uses {s?o}, whose o format accepts the value without that check.","consequence":"The wrong-type member is not rejected by the fixed entry.","equivalence_reason":"This concerns type validation itself, which is distinct from reporting the member key in a diagnostic."}]}
